subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

VISIBLE
solution: The correct answer is **"Apparent"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let us understand the **meaning** of the given and the marked **words.** • **Visible **means **something that is capable of being discovered or noticed**. (कुछ ऐसा जो खोजा या देखा जा सके) • **Synonyms**: Observable or viewable. • **Example**: *The house is clearly **visible** from the beach.* • **Apparent **means** something clear, obvious or can be easily observed**. (कुछ स्पष्ट, स्पष्ट या आसानी से देखा जा सकता है) • **Synonyms**: Evident or noticeable or recognizable. • **Example**: *Her happiness was **apparent** to everyone.* • From the above explanation, it is clear that the word **"apparent" is the synonym of "visible"**. • Hence, the **correct answer is option 2) Apparent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us understand the **meaning** of the other given **words.** • **Secret **means something that is not or must not be known to other people. (ऐसा कुछ जो अन्य लोगों को ज्ञात नहीं है या नहीं होना चाहिए।) • **Vague** means something that is not clear or definite. (कुछ ऐसा जो स्पष्ट या निश्चित न हो।) • **Hidden **means something/someone being out of sight or not readily evident. (कुछ / कोई दृष्टि से बाहर हो रहा है या आसानी से स्पष्ट नहीं है।) 2f:Tc24, The correct answer is "**efficiently**".
